ORDINANCE VII OF 1983
An Ordinance
further to amend the Zakat and Ushr Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 26th February, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.-this Ordinance may be called the Zakat and Ushr (Amendment)
Ordinance, 1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 16,
Ordinance XVIII of 1980.-In the Zakat and Ushr Ordinance, 1980 (XVIII of
1980), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 16, in
subsection (3),-
(a) after the
word and comma "district,", the word "and" shall be
inserted ;
(b) the words
"and one member to be nominated by the District Council of the district
from amongst its non-official Muslim members" shall be omitted ; and
(c) in the first
proviso, for the commas and words, "the Deputy Commis sioner and the
member nominated by the District Council," the words "and the Deputy
Commissioner" shall be substituted.

ZAKAT AND USHR
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
ORDINANCE VII OF 1983
An Ordinance
further to amend the Zakat and Ushr Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 26th February, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
4. Amendment of section 18,
Ordinance XVIII of 1980.-In the said Ordinance, in section 18,-
(a) in subsection (3), the words
and commas occurring after the brackets and figure "(4)" shall be
omitted ;
(b) in subsection (4),-
(i) for the
words "two or more persons" the words and commas "three or more
persons, including at
least one
gazetted officer, one aalim-e-deen and one member of the District
Committee," shall be substituted ;
(ii) after the
word "who", the words "are known to be pious and not engaged in
political activity and who" shall be inserted ;
(iii) in the
proviso, after the words "local authority" the words "other wise
than as a Pesh Imam of a local mosque or a teacher of a local school"
shall be inserted and for the full-stop at the end a colon shall be substituted
; and
(iv) after the
proviso, amended as aforesaid, the following further proviso shall be added,
namely :-
"Provided
further that, where in a district the number of Local Com mittees is so large
that the members of the District Committee cannot be put on all the teams
constituted for the selection of members of Local Committees in the district,
the District Committee, may, at its discretion, nominate any other non-official
person of the district to represent it on the said team." ;
(c) in subsection (6), after the
word and comma "disqualifications,", the words and commas "or is
not known to be pious, or is known to be engaged in political activity,"
shall be inserted ; and
(d) in subsection (7),-
(i) for the
words "preferably a person who is literate" the words "being a
person who is literate and who offers prayer five times a day regularly and
observes the fast throughout Ramzan-ul-Mubarak according to the Injunctions of
Islam" shall be substituted ; and
(ii) for the
full-stop at the end a colon shall be substituted and thereafter the following
proviso shall be added, namely :-
"Provided
that the condition of the Chairman being literate may be waived in a locality
where no literate, pious and practising Muslim is available." `

(ii) after

namely :-
"(e)
has a majority of members who are not pious Muslims or who are engaged in

(2) in subsection .(3),-
(a) in clause
(a),-
(i) in sub-clause
(i), after the word "a", the word "pious" shall be inserted
;
(ii) in

(vi) engaged in

Amendment of section 21-A, Ordinance XVIII of 1930

ORDINANCE VII OF 1983

[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 26th February, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
6. Amendment of section 21-A,
Ordinance XVIII of 1930.-In the said Ordinance, in section 21-A,-
(a) in the
marginal heading, after the words "Local Committee" at the end, the
words "or a Local Committee as a whole" shall be added ;
(b) for
subsection (2) the following shall be substituted, namely
"(2) Where
in the case of a member of a Local Committee, or of a Local Committee as a
whole; the District Committee, after such enquiry as it may deem fit, is of the
opinion that the adult Muslim residents of the locality no longer have
confidence in the member, or in the Committee as a whole, the District
Committee may, in the prescribed manner, remove the member from his office or
dissolve the Committee as a whole." ; and
(c) in subsection (3), after the
word "member", the words "or members" shall be inserted.
